projects.title: Visionserver
bullets: Built a C++ vision-processing library for Raspberry Pi deployment on a competition robot, spanning nearly 6,000 files across C, C++, and NASL.
Configured continuous integration to validate builds, sustaining active development across 200 commits over 86 days.

projects.title: UE5 Lidarsim
bullets: Built a lidar simulation in Unreal Engine 5 to model obstacle detection for a competition robot, in C++ and C#.
Iterated over 38 active days and 55 commits, coordinating changes across a multi-language codebase of roughly 300 files.

projects.title: Swerve Simulation
bullets: Extended a Java swerve-drive simulation from an earlier robotics project, adding drivetrain calculations validated with JUnit and the Jama matrix library.
Wrote JUnit test suites covering the simulation logic, sustaining development across 51 files over 33 active days.

leadership.title: Vision Systems Contributor
bullets: After teammates struggled to reproduce intermittent vision failures during practice runs, began logging the conditions behind each failure before proposing a fix.
Traced late-season failures to code that had never been exercised outside competition, shifting focus toward testing before deployment.

awards.title: Regional Robotics Tournament — Technical Inspection Award
